CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.UstalStatusZnakRKN ( @GIDTyp1 smallint, @ZnakTR1 smallint, @GIDTyp2 smallint, @ZnakTR2 smallint, @StronaRK smallint, @Wycena tinyint, @RKN_Status smallint output, @RKN_StatusID int output, @RKN_Znak smallint output)
AS
if (@GIDTyp1 = 784 and @GIDTyp2 = 784) or (@GIDTyp1 <> 784 and @GIDTyp2 <> 784 and ((@ZnakTR1 = 1 and @ZnakTR2 = 2) or (@ZnakTR2 = 1 and @ZnakTR1 = 2))) set @RKN_Status = 105 --kompensaty else if (@GIDTyp1 = 784 and @GIDTyp2 <> 784 and @ZnakTR1 = 1) or (@GIDTyp2 = 784 and @GIDTyp1 <> 784 and @ZnakTR2 = 1) set @RKN_Status = 104 --rozchody else if (@GIDTyp1 = 784 and @GIDTyp2 <> 784 and @ZnakTR1 = 2) or (@GIDTyp2 = 784 and @GIDTyp1 <> 784 and @ZnakTR2 = 2) set @RKN_Status = 103 --przychody else set @RKN_Status = -1
if @RKN_Status <> -1 begin set @RKN_StatusID = (select top 1 SLW_ID from cdn.Slowniki with(nolock) where SLW_Predefiniowany = @RKN_Status) if isnull(@RKN_StatusID,0) = 0 set @RKN_Status = -1 end
if (@GIDTyp1 = 784 and @GIDTyp2 = 784) and @Wycena <> 0 begin if @StronaRK = 2 begin if @ZnakTR2 = 1 set @RKN_Znak = 1 --dodatnia else set @RKN_Znak = 2 --ujemna end else begin if @ZnakTR1 = 1 set @RKN_Znak = 1 --dodatnia else set @RKN_Znak = 2 --ujemna end end else begin if @StronaRK = 2 begin if @ZnakTR2 = 1 set @RKN_Znak = 2 --ujemna else set @RKN_Znak = 1 --dodatnia end else begin if @ZnakTR1 = 1 set @RKN_Znak = 2 --ujemna else set @RKN_Znak = 1 --dodatnia end end
